**Method notes**

- Inclusion rule: S&P 500 membership (live Wikipedia list, 503 symbols) **or** market cap above $50B.
- 37 S&P 500 names and 6 non-index mega-caps qualified: ET $70.0B, ITUB $82.6B, SU $88.2B, RACE $88.6B, TRI $53.0B and SHOP $201.0B.
- The $50B line itself is the tight boundary — KDP $50.1B is the only name inside by 0.1B and was confirmed by Keurig Dr Pepper's own IR release.
- Roster construction used the union of five calendars (EarningsWhispers 243, Nasdaq 279, MarketBeat 243, Yahoo 300, Digrin 521) rather than one feed.
- The EarningsWhispers+Nasdaq pair alone missed AES and ET; the wider sweep additionally surfaced LITE, GPN, LYV, TECH and EA — every one of which company sources then rejected or re-dated.
- Every name on the final list appears in at least two independent calendars, and every headline name plus every boundary name was confirmed against a company source.
- Status is `pending` for all 43:
- the aggregator actuals columns showed a result only for PHG across the entire 243-name roster at the snapshot time, and PHG is not in scope.
- Time zone for all times is US/Eastern; the snapshot was taken at 06:13 ET on 2026-11-03, 2h30m before the 08:30 ET pre-market brief that consumes this file.
- This is a read-only reminder: no analyst price targets, no valuation work, no earnings reaction.
